label: Causal propagation of brute contingency under fixed governing laws
summary: The same contingent, uncaused founder without any #312 existence reason is modeled under three population boundaries. Conservation of persistent individuals excludes late entry. Capacity one permits the same late candidate in the founder’s absence yet excludes it alongside the founder. Unrestricted birth inputs admit an additional uncaused agent at every specified later tick, preserving prior presences and changing one detector. This defeats the bare shared-premise inference without adjudicating which boundary is metaphysically necessary. Paired interventions on a connected three-site path give every pair assignment and preserve total parity; one optional unmatched endpoint flip gives all triples. In a fixed XOR evidence channel the truth of a measured change survives precisely when its two offsets agree. The subject note compares closure of a calibrated inventory, dispositional, best-system, necessitarian and classical-theistic restrictions, the same-agent strict-norm conflict, matched standards of explanatory adequacy, and the existing B2/C2 routes. #1874’s independent infinite-closure obligation remains. One can exclude a specified change on a retained target by accounting exhaustively for its ways of receiving influence, even if the source inventory stays open. A violation can reveal an unmodeled coupling while leaving its bearer’s existential origin open. All three formal results passed binding, Comparator and NanoDa. The existing c056ad5c excludes two actual concrete roots of the same grounding relation at a selected world under its other-cause, identity-uniqueness and application premises. It needs no necessary founder. Transport to retained-founder continuations and replacement of local absence of production by actual grounding-root status are separate application obligations.
blocker: The repeatable new-agent insertion route needs warrant for an unreceived onset and joint composition of its origins and exercises at the fixed background. One effective eligible addition defeats a universal ban. Other mechanisms, including separately admitted rich initial inputs, can produce arbitrary joint outputs without late entry. Crossing the particular parity boundary requires some effective change that breaks its invariant. Universal exclusion of entrants requires essential exhaustive closure or universal receipt of existence. Actual epistemic defeat needs evidence about exposure of reliable channels and the inquirer’s own entitlement standard.

current_assessment.scope: The integrated containment comparison for exceptions to adequate existential explanation, including the strictly weaker observable consequences available before complete-history richness and the remaining admission, transmission and epistemic bridges. The original three population boundaries, causal controls and actual-root uniqueness interpretation retain their own scope.
current_assessment.assessment: No inference from one brute contingent existent to unrestricted possibility is established. Within the fixed Boolean selector interpretation, single-time richness is exactly the obstruction to a uniformly exact old-record forecast, and adjacent-pair richness is exactly the obstruction to a universal first-order transition profile excluding a wholly future adjacent pair. Two constant suffixes separate the first two levels; four parity-recursive suffixes separate adjacent-pair from finite richness while obeying a common deterministic law with two-bit memory. The existing eventual-constancy control separates finite from whole-suffix richness. This weakens the assumptions for these selected local consequences without proving the metaphysical admission of any such family. The reverse profile characterization supplies an extensional restriction, not its warrant or governance. A warranted necessary or primitive restriction may genuinely terminate a containment demand; explaining an exemption still does not explain the actual existence of its bearer. The strongest developed rival candidate retains a stable brute foundation, constitutive and history restrictions with the needed scope, and fallible causal or prima facie warrant. It remains a candidate package, not a certified globally possible worldview. Classical theism has conditional additional explanatory content if it supplies adequate actual existential explanation and reason-guided production; necessity alone supplies neither agency nor trustworthy historical access. The prior moderate preference for E and suspension about universal determining D are retained, not strengthened by counting formal consequences. Internal contradiction requires the rival's own incompatible exclusion or entitlement norm plus its admitted countercase; bruteness alone does not supply it.
current_assessment.next_test: Fix a serious constitutive or dispositional restriction and a proposed new coupling to the same retained target. Establish why the restriction covers every effective unmatched input, or positively warrant a counterinstance. Separately give a full-history alternative explicit identities, provenance and operational states, preserving the commitments required by the selected interpretation, and assess a history-sensitive channel or fallible warrant. Qualitative replacements may differ in numerical identity and historical origin. Connect adequate explanation, actual production and reason-guided exercise to the same necessary source before claiming an advantage over necessary impersonal foundations. The existence-PSR to B2 route retains its original BX1/BX2 and domain/adequacy obligations; neither new batch discharges them.
current_assessment.evidence: Independent semantic challenge of a6daf0148bc707e953610cc131ef78fcb249cff9 covered all four new result bundles, their definitions and controls, both new note sections, the complete comparative judgment and diagram, both current assessments and the PR summary. It found four P1 scope errors: strict forecasting versus explanatory parity, unnecessary preservation of historical identities/provenance, sufficient matching presented as necessary, and omitted wholly-future profile scope. These and the quantitative/common-record wording corrections were repaired. Targeted recheck 1 accepted the repaired scope at local 98818b057e9f557eec4b29112184ce8c26a23d13, whose exact tree is published as 9c9cf4fc1f1786f6201c0d453789936d399ee0cc. The recheck also accepted the primitive-list classifier proof repair, which preserves the frozen proposition and zero-axiom allowance. Both frozen Challenges are unchanged. Published in PR-1927; mechanical verification is recorded in its CI checks. Acceptance is of the qualified interpretation and synthesis, not metaphysical admissibility, premise establishment, skeptical defeat or root closure.
current_assessment.supersedes: For local forecast and first-order profile obstructions only, supersedes any reading of the earlier summary's independent infinite-closure obligation as necessary for those weaker consequences. Infinite closure remains a separate obligation for whole-suffix richness. Preserves the original capacity-one, intervention, fixed-offset and uniqueness findings, the stronger metaphysical admission blocker, and the actual epistemic-defeat qualifications. No earlier substantive PSR, C2 or attribute judgment is withdrawn, and no root premise is claimed established.
